_note: Ground truth for the fixture scene, found by hand-checking bright blobs against the DMA AIS slice. Pixel coordinates are in the fixture TIFF (row, col). distance_m is the distance between the blob (geolocated via the GCPs, time taken from its row) and the AIS track linearly interpolated to that time. Labels are weak: they say 'matched an AIS track', not 'is a ship'.

known_false_alarms.note: bright spot on the island: a plain threshold DOES pick it up, only a land mask removes it. An AIS station (MMSI 219026516, SOG 0.1) sits 34 m away, so it is not an open-water ship
